_doc: Single source of truth for releases (docs/RELEASE_SOURCE.md). Every published build (OTA, APK, desktop) must come from a commit on this branch. Change only with the owner's approval.
_doc_ota: dispatch_only: workflows that may start ONLY from a manual run (Actions > Run workflow); release_guard.py lint refuses any other trigger. ota_publishers: GitHub accounts allowed to start an OTA publication (each must also be a repository admin; checked from GitHub's authenticated actor by tools/ota_request.py). Change only with the owner's approval.
